items.title: Cursor ships Cloud Agent Canvases — agents now build shareable visual outputs, not just text
items.summary: Cloud agents can generate interactive canvases (dashboards, diagrams, custom review tools) as part of their work and share a finished one via link. A new Environments API (beta) lets you create and manage cloud agent environments programmatically, and environments now scale to 300 repos and load 5x faster.
items.why: A coding agent that hands you back a working visual artifact instead of a wall of text is a real jump for anything beyond quick text review.
items.action: Next time a cloud agent finishes a multi-file change, ask it to build a canvas summarizing the diff and impact instead of a text PR description.

items.title: Google open-sources agent-eval, a toolkit for moving agent testing past the "vibe check"
items.summary: A framework-agnostic evaluation methodology plus an open-source scaffolding tool, agent-eval, that runs multi-turn scenarios, captures traces, and generates a pass/fail and root-cause report.
items.why: A full day-0/day-1/day-2 playbook for turning agent testing into an actual CI-gated eval suite, published by a major vendor.
items.action: Do a manual review pass on 10-20 of your own agent's traces before writing a single metric, per the post's recommended first step.
